name: 喵呜
evolution: 喵喵 → 喵呜 Lv.16 → 魔力猫 Lv.32 → 叶冕魔力猫；喵喵 → 喵呜 Lv.16 → 魔力猫 Lv.32 → 武斗酷猫
evolutionEn: Meevy → Miaowu Lv.16 → Molimao Lv.32 → Yemianmolimao; Meevy → Miaowu Lv.16 → Molimao Lv.32 → Wudoukumao
description: 爱在泉水边嬉戏，是喵喵的进化型，芭蕉叶状的尾巴变成了两条。胆量变大了，会经常吐舌头挑衅对手。
descriptionEn: Loves to play by the spring. It is the evolved form of Meevy, and its banana-leaf-shaped tail has become two. It has grown bolder and often sticks out its tongue to provoke opponents.
